name: Trackstead
description: A local-first multitrack audio sketchbook: arrange, trim and split clips, balance tracks, capture an opt-in mic take, save projects, and export stereo WAV.
inspiration: REAPER's linear, nondestructive multitrack workflow; original interface and assets.
distinction: Linear multitrack arrangement. Complements Wave Room's single-file editing and the FL-inspired pattern sequencer.
limitations: No MIDI, plug-ins, time stretching, live input monitoring, or REAPER project compatibility. Microphone hardware not tested.
